text:
Rin (Design): dropped a compact 'Rollback Preview' prototype — lightweight slide-over from the timeline. shows small diff excerpt, rollout type tag (canary/release), and a short help line. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc/rollback-preview

Marta (PM): nice. can we show if the revision had partial canary data? important for metrics people.

Rin (Design): added a small tag 'canary (partial)' when applicable and a tooltip explaining metrics might be incomplete.

Ike (Eng): implementation note: diff HTML should be lazy-loaded for large revisions and we should expose a simple endpoint for 'safe' vs 'immediate' rollback actions. avoid heavy client work on long timelines.

June (A11y): a11y nits: the slide-over must have role="dialog", focus trap, and a visible close target. the canary tag needs an accessible name not just color.

Rin (Design): will add aria-label: "Revision 23, canary (partial), created by Alex" and keyboard docs in handoff.

Marta (PM): microcopy ask: change CTA to "Revert to this revision" and add one-line clarification: "Routes traffic and switches model version. Runtime flags unchanged."

Ike (Eng): also add an undo affordance: non-blocking toast with "Undo" for 3 minutes. server will expose undo endpoint; UI just shows the toast. debounce double-clicks server-side.

June (A11y): ensure toast is accessible (aria-live="polite") and keyboard-focusable for undo. also don't auto-collapse the dialog on undo success without announcing result.

Rin (Design): updated mock: slide-over confirm + toast undo 3m. small alert for "canary-only snapshot: metrics incomplete" included.

Marta (PM): let's A/B test two variants: slide-over confirm (current) vs inline micro-popover confirm. metrics: rollback_attempt, rollback_confirmed, rollback_undo_3m, accidental_rollback_rate. experiment ids: rollback_slide_v1, rollback_popover_v1.

ops-bot: snapshot created for design file 'rollback-preview' by Rin at 1767234615

Ike (Eng): i'll prototype lazy load + undo toast behavior this sprint. ping me for the event schema.

Rin (Design): thanks — i'll update the handoff with aria snippets and experiment IDs. schedule a short review after the prototype. :thumbsup:
